name: SC-04
label: Likely R

key_factors: Incumbency advantage in a low-attention race
model.rationale: The district's R+11 lean, Timmons' incumbency and overwhelming financial edge, and markets pricing him at 94% all point to a safe Republican hold; McClain's minimal fundraising gives no evidence of competitiveness.
model.watch: Any late outside spending against Timmons or a polling surprise would be the only realistic path to narrowing this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
South Carolina's 4th District is solidly Republican territory, and incumbent William Timmons is seeking another term after easily securing renomination. His campaign has raised about $1.6 million with outside support on top, while Democratic challenger Courtney McClain has raised roughly $33,000 and reports minimal cash on hand. A Libertarian candidate is also on the ballot but has negligible resources.

No public polls or expert ratings cover this race, but prediction markets give Timmons about a 94% chance of winning. With the district's strong partisan lean and the incumbent's financial dominance, the seat is expected to remain comfortably in Republican hands.
